The main takeaway from our work is that
the loss of HR variability in sepsis is a consequence of a reduction in the amplitude and phase coherence of the autonomic oscillators that regulate heart rate.
the loss of HR dynamics in endotoxemic patients is a result of the loss of the autonomic oscillatory signals.
